Clarity is pursuing a different model by adding inspection technology at the point where merchandise is returned or received, allowing retailers to evaluate individual products rather than relying solely on policy restrictions. Its machines combine diagnostic-grade X-ray intelligence with computer vision and proprietary AI models.
